title: Provider fix: 常時Contextに載っていたTool説明をon-demand skillへ移し、5.7k→1k tokensへ削減
summary: Claude Code v2.1.248 cut the Workflow tool's prompt footprint from about 5.7k tokens to about 1k by moving the script-writing reference out of the always-loaded tool description and into a bundled workflow-authoring skill that loads only when authoring is actually happening. This is first-party confirmation of the catalogued mechanism that task-specific procedure text kept permanently in context is a standing token tax, and it demonstrates the standard remedy - split reference material into a conditionally-loaded skill rather than trimming prose.

evidence.summary: 'Improved the Workflow tool's prompt footprint: its description is now about 1k tokens instead of 5.7k, with the script-writing reference moved into a bundled workflow-authoring skill.'

notes: Vendor-side validation of D06 (task-specific procedures kept permanently in context) and closely related to P-20260816-66F0FD78 (skills inducing token/time cost out of proportion to quality gain). No new mechanism - recorded so both entries can cite a quantified first-party before/after (5.7k -> 1k tokens) and the split-into-conditional-skill remedy.
